identity.title: ALMA Detected Overdensity of Sub-millimeter Sources Around WISE/NVSS-selected z ~ 2 Dusty Quasars

paper_type_evidence.quote: This study demonstrates the utility of environmental studies using archival ALMA images, which allow us to sample at high resolution the dense cores of potential proto-clusters.
